recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14721 unless a future work group decision revives the retired resource; any such revival should start from the historical CatalogEntry name unless a new Jira decision says otherwise.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive OO FHIR-core issue raised against STU3 EntryDefinition and applied for R4; it requested a more meaningful name because EntryDefinition did not tell implementers how or where the resource would be used. The accepted resolution was to rename the resource CatalogEntry.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-14721, but commit d881c57c69c8f8bc0f0f01a37255f23090629f59 directly changed active build-support references from EntryDefinition to CatalogEntry in source/fhir.ini, source/hierarchy.xml, source/history.html, source/resourcelist.html, and related CatalogEntry files. A contemporaneous Zulip committers thread announced the same rename and impacted files, and OO 2018-10-03 WGM minutes recorded both the rename and the Persuasive vote for tracker 14721.
additional_context: Later CatalogEntry decisions superseded the active-resource context. FHIR-30632 recorded the intent to remove CatalogEntry in R5, and FHIR-28177 then removed CatalogEntry from the active core build because OO found it no longer useful or maintained. Commit 47b44e3ba15773f30f6d96fb210fd61213363a88 removed catalogentry from active fhir.ini build entries and deleted source/catalogentry. Current fhir.ini has no active catalogentry or entrydefinition entry; the remaining source/entrydefinition directory is stale/out of build scope, while CatalogEntry remains only in historical metadata.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the requested rename was already applied historically, and there is no active current-build EntryDefinition/CatalogEntry resource needing a rename fix.
